§6Fueling Station§f automatically loads fuel into docked rockets, replacing the manual bucket-fill workflow. It links to a rocket via a Linker and pulls from adjacent Fluid Tanks or Fluid Ducts.

Craft it: Machine Structure, User Interface, Liquid IO Circuit Board, Steel Fan, and Tin Plates in the pattern 'b g b / l b f / p p p'. The station is a Network Machine and must be part of a network controlled by a Guidance Computer or Planet Holo Selector.

It can move monopropellant, bipropellant fuel, and oxidizer into the rocket's tanks in parallel.

§ePS:§f Place the station adjacent to a fluid tank with a Liquid IO Board on the side facing the tank. The station pulls directly without needing a pump. For bipropellant, route fuel and oxidizer through separate ducts to the same station.
